# Cancellation & refund policy — `cancellation.dc.html`

**Shell:** `SPEC-legal-shell.md` · **Sections:** 9 · **Status:** built 4 Aug 2026
**This page is designed to supersede** the FAQ and the terms on every number it states.

## 1. Structure

```
01 What you get back      06 No-show
02 How to cancel          07 Snow, strikes, closures
03 Changing a booking     08 How refunds are paid
04 Flight delays          09 Vouchers
05 If no driver arrives
```

An `Alert tone="accent"` sits above section 01: *This page governs.* It is the only yellow
attention surface on the page, and it exists because the archive contains two different refund
promises to the same customer.

## 2. The tier block — section 01

Three cards, one grid row from 640px, stacked below. Each card: uppercase kicker (*More than* /
*Inside* / *After pickup time*), an h3 carrying the window, a `--vt-figure-md` token for the share,
and one sentence of reason.

- Rhythm borrowed from `700 web` /Main/43 — node **30:1653**: equal columns, generous internal
  gutter, 16/24 supporting copy. Values are Vamos tokens, not the source's.
- The shares are **tokens**, at figure size, in charcoal on yellow-50. Charcoal because
  #A67B05 on #FFFBEE measures 3.72:1 — see the shell's colour table.
- No card is “recommended”: yellow means action, and a 2px charcoal border means *chosen*. A
  refund tier is neither.
- Below the three cards, a grey-50 strip carries the large-vehicle exception, so the coach rule
  does not need a fourth column that is empty for 99% of readers.
- Prints three-up, borders black, shadows off.

## 3. Decision flags — 2

| Section | Conflict |
|---|---|
| 01 | **Ship-blocking.** Archived FAQ promises a full refund up to 24h; archived terms grant 75% and retain 25%. Customers will quote the generous one |
| 02 | Terms require a “My Reservations” account; FAQ says chat, WhatsApp or email; no account UI was publicly reachable |

## 4. Two cancellation paths — section 02

Guest (token link from the confirmation email) and account, side by side as equal cards from
760px, each with its own `ghost` button. Telephone is named underneath as the fallback, not as a
third card — it is what you do when the other two fail.

## 5. Slots — 3 · Tokens — 18

Slots: consequential costs when no driver arrives (05) · disruption outcome (07) · voucher terms
(09).

Tokens: effective date · version · free-cancel window · full, partial and no-show shares ·
large-vehicle seats and window · modification deadline · driver no-show share · airport and
standard waiting · call attempts · extra waiting rate · refund decision days · payout days ·
voucher validity · complaint resolution days.

## 6. Notes

- Section 04 gives the flight-delay answer in three bullets, including the one nobody writes down:
  no flight number means we cannot see the delay, so ordinary waiting rules apply.
- Section 08 states that refunds only ever go back to the original payment method — the single
  most common support question after “where is my driver”.
- Vouchers are framed honestly: the voucher is worth more than the refunded share, which is why
  it is offered.
